description: This file contains handlers for managing agent nodes, including registration, listing, heartbeat processing, status updates, and serverless agent discovery. It also includes logic for callback URL validation, cache management for heartbeat data, and integration with lifecycle and status management systems.

classes.name: readCloser
classes.description: A simple wrapper struct implementing io.ReadCloser for reusing request bodies during JSON binding.

classes.name: CachedNodeData
classes.description: Holds cached heartbeat information for a node to avoid excessive database writes.

classes.name: HeartbeatCache
classes.description: Manages cached heartbeat data with thread-safe access to determine when to update the database.

methods.name: validateCallbackURL
methods.description: Validates that a callback URL is properly formatted, reachable, and uses HTTP or HTTPS scheme with a health check.

methods.name: extractPortFromURL
methods.description: Extracts the port number from a URL, or defaults to 80/443 based on scheme.

methods.name: gatherCallbackCandidates
methods.description: Gathers and deduplicates callback URL candidates from base URL and discovery info.

methods.name: normalizeCandidate
methods.description: Converts raw callback candidate strings into normalized, full URL forms with proper scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: probeCandidate
methods.description: Probes a candidate callback URL to check health/status endpoints and returns a test result.

methods.name: resolveCallbackCandidates
methods.description: Resolves a list of candidate URLs into one that successfully responds to health checks, with normalized form.

methods.name: processHeartbeatAsync
methods.description: Performs asynchronous database update of node heartbeat to prevent blocking.
